content.summary: A glacial surveyor discovers a whale-like machine beneath one ice wall. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult observer and one route establish human scale. + One bounded sensory clue appears before the complete creature form. + Creature geometry emerges from the established terrain rather than entering from elsewhere. + The observer remains visible through the scale escalation. + The final wide frame reconnects complete creature feature, observer and original geography.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult glacial surveyor with a yellow shell and black pack on a fixed blue-ice path. Let translucent scale plates and one whale-like mechanical head emerge from that exact wall while she stops at the same marker. Pull wide to hold the head, one fin edge, surveyor and original blue-ice route in one readable scale frame.
